description:
The process begins when a customer files a complaint about a product or service.
Customer service logs the complaint and assigns it to the relevant department for investigation.
After reviewing the details, the team determines whether the complaint is valid and whether a refund is justified and notifies the customer with the decision.
If a refund is approved, the financial team processes the reimbursement.
The complaint is marked as resolved once the customer receives the refund or directly after notifying the customer in case the refund was rejected.
After resolving the case, customers can provide feedback on their satisfaction.

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssessComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyCustomer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ResolutionMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MarkResolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundDecision" name="Refund approved?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProcessRefund" name="Process reimbursement" messageRef="Message_Refund"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ResolutionMerge" name="Continue to resolution"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MarkResolved" name="Mark complaint resolved"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ComplaintResolved" name="Complaint resolved"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_Log" sourceRef="Start_ComplaintReceived" targetRef="Task_LogComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Log_Assign" sourceRef="Task_LogComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssignComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assign_Review" sourceRef="Task_AssignComplaint" targetRef="Task_ReviewDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Assess" sourceRef="Task_ReviewDetails" targetRef="Task_AssessComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assess_Notify" sourceRef="Task_AssessComplaint" targetRef="Task_NotifyCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_Decision" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_RefundDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundApproved" name="Refund approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Task_ProcessRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refundApproved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundNotApproved" name="Refund not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ResolutionMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not refundApproved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResolutionMerge_Mark" sourceRef="Gateway_ResolutionMerge" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Mark_End" sourceRef="Task_MarkResolved" targetRef="End_ComplaintResolved"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="File complaint and provide feedback" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_FileComplaint" name="File complaint" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDecision" name="Receive complaint decision" messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerRefundDecision" name="Refund approved?"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveRefund" name="Receive refund" messageRef="Message_Refund"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ProvideFeedback" name="Provide feedback?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideFeedback" name="Provide satisfaction feedback" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerNoFeedback" name="No feedback provided"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerFeedbackProvided" name="Feedback provided"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerStart_File" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_FileComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_File_ReceiveDecision" sourceRef="Task_FileComplaint" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveDecision_RefundDecision" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerRefundDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerRefundApproved" name="Refund approved" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerRefundDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refundApproved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerRefundNotApproved" name="Refund not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerRefundDecision" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerResolutionMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not refundApproved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveRefund_ResolutionMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRefund" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerResolutionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResolutionMerge_FeedbackChoice" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerResolutionMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ProvideFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProvideFeedback_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">provideFeedback</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProvideFeedback_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="End_CustomerNoFeedback">

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Filed complaint" sourceRef="Task_FileComplaint" targetRef="Start_ComplaintReceived" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Decision" name="Complaint decision" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Refund" name="Refund" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefund" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRefund" messageRef="Message_Refund"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Customer feedback" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="Participant_Organization" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
